title: Simple Emojis
description: This mod adds twemojis to minecraft
body:
# Better Emojis

Better Emojis adds a large emoji library to Minecraft, making chat more expressive with an in-game emoji picker and shortcode support.
 ![looks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c4941899dbf32cba13eff00c74be6387552d1b5.png)

## Features

- 4,009 emojis included
- Emoji picker with organized categories
- Shortcode support for quickly typing emojis
- Works with Minecraft 1.20.1 - 1.20.5
- Frequent updates every 2-4 days
- Designed for players who want cleaner, more expressive chat

## How to Use

Open the emoji menu in-game, browse by category, and select an emoji to insert it into chat.

You can also type supported shortcodes, such as:

```text
:smile:
:heart:
:joy:
